subcategory_text: Mechanisms for transmitting processing permissions and related data values with data elements are established and in place.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: SC-16 (Transmission of Security and Privacy Attributes), AC-4 (Information Flow Enforcement)
implementation_examples: Define and propagate processing permissions and related data values (consent, lawful basis, retention class) with the data elements themselves so that downstream systems honour origin authorisations
Use policy-stamp or attribute-based controls where architectural support is available
Audit propagation completeness on a sample basis
assessment_objectives: Determine whether processing permissions travel with the data
Determine whether the propagation mechanism is documented
Determine whether downstream systems honour the transmitted permissions
Determine whether propagation completeness is audited
